'''FC Iberia 1999''' ({{Langx|ka|იბერია 1999}}), formerly known as '''FC Saburtalo''', is a [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] [[association football|football]] club,<ref name="soccerway">{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/georgia/saburtalo/24902/|title=Georgia – FC Saburtalo Tbilisi – Results, fixtures, squad, statistics, photos, videos and news – Soccerway|publisher=uk.soccerway.com|access-date=2015-02-18}}</ref> based in the [[Saburtalo District]] of [[Tbilisi]], the capital of the country.

Since the introduction of the [[Erovnuli Liga]] in 2017, they have been the most decorated Georgian team with seven top titles.{{citation needed|date=August 2026}}"}}
